bootstrap.method: paired opening-cluster bootstrap; resample openings and preserve both seat outcomes within each opening

coverage_comparison.difference: B minus A seat-averaged game score
coverage_comparison.pass_rule: lower endpoint strictly greater than zero
coverage_comparison.per_opening_cluster: difference between B and A mean designated-player score over both seat assignments

primary_strength.bootstrap_bound: one-sided paired 95% percentile lower confidence bound
primary_strength.per_opening_cluster: mean of B designated-player score over both seat assignments

opening_generation: independent legal uniform-random 12-ply prefixes; unique canonical starts; reject starts matching selected training states in canonical or production float32 identity
search: serving PUCT configuration including native exact-root behavior
seating: paired seat-swapped games for every opening and comparison

thresholds.coverage_comparison: paired two-sided 95% interval for B minus A seat-averaged score on the same openings; lower endpoint strictly > 0
thresholds.primary_strength: one-sided paired 95% lower confidence bound for B versus serving P-E4 seat-averaged score strictly > 0.50
thresholds.secondary_generalization: report held-out masked policy cross-entropy for A and B; diagnostic only, not a pass gate

trajectory_overlap: report exact canonical and float32 overlap counts against both training arms; not yet observed
value_evaluator: serving P-E4, unchanged and common to all policies
